scope: Read-only independent audit of the requested Practical recommendations heading-style change. Paper sources are not edited by this audit.

diff: The evaluation has several constraints. ClinVar labels may reflect submission bias and future updates \cite{Landrum2020ClinVar}. Unknown development-data overlap for CADD and AlphaMissense limits prospective interpretation. Protein-level mapping omits isoform and residue-specific effects. STRING associations extend beyond direct physical interactions \cite{Szklarczyk2023STRING}; transductive propagation and direct-edge ablation retain indirect cross-partition paths. Outputs from class-weighted training are not calibrated clinical probabilities, and transition counts depend on the chosen threshold. The external set excludes specified variants/proteins but not all homologues or shared annotation evidence; external clinical-score fusion was not evaluated. These findings concern fixed propagation and should not be generalized to trained graph neural networks.

Compare graph features with raw embeddings and strong score baselines under matched training settings. State whether held-out proteins remain visible in the graph, assess uncertainty at the protein level, and treat selected topology groups as hypotheses. Check calibration and decision thresholds before clinical use.
